# WaveR

The goal of WaveR is to facilitate code-reuse between Wave projects
using standardized functions.

## Installation

You can install the development version of WaveR from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("StudioBandLLC/WaveR")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(WaveR)

# Runs at the start of a project to load the common configurations and 
# settings 

use_wave()
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`COLORS`](https://rollie-band.github.io/WaveR/reference/COLORS.md) :
  Vector of custom colors for Wave projects
- [`connect_gmail()`](https://rollie-band.github.io/WaveR/reference/connect_gmail.md)
  : Load the SMTP connection variables for sending email via Gmail.
- [`connect_snowflake()`](https://rollie-band.github.io/WaveR/reference/connect_snowflake.md)
  : Set up a Snowflake connection object to the specified database &
  schema
- [`connect_supabase()`](https://rollie-band.github.io/WaveR/reference/connect_supabase.md)
  : Set up a Supbabase connection object to the specified CapeGlobal App
- [`get_secrets()`](https://rollie-band.github.io/WaveR/reference/get_secrets.md)
  : Loads secrets from Inifisical during interactive sessions
- [`use_wave()`](https://rollie-band.github.io/WaveR/reference/use_wave.md)
  : Use the default Wave settings
